Hi Sofia / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps: 

- Current priority: roll out a secure low-latency LLM inference layer for your care-coordination product by Q4.
- Key constraints: PHI handling, VPC-only deployment for initial rollout, and tight p95 latency targets for 512-token prompts.
- What we heard: smaller pilot (1-2 endpoints) to validate latency/cost, then expand to 10+ endpoints for production.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) — to confirm org-level requirements and procurement cadence. Ideal participants: your CTO or VP of Engineering + our CTO (Vivek).
2) Technical deep-dive / demo — 60-75min with your infra and ML engineers to walk the runtime, security controls (KMS, audit logs), and perf benchmarks.
3) Draft mutual action plan & T&Cs — I attached a short pricing brief and a draft MAP to speed procurement.

Can you confirm which of the following windows works for the VP/CTO intro? I’ve left them intentionally broad so we can align calendars: 
- Thu Mar 26, 9:00-10:00 PT or 11:00-12:00 PT
- Fri Mar 27, 13:00-14:00 PT

If none of those fit, propose 2 alternatives and I’ll loop in Vivek and Ethan.

Attached: redwood-pricing-brief.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
